questions.question:
A: What will we do in Alishan?
B: We will go ______. The mountains are beautiful.
questions.explanation: 在山區 (mountains) 常見的活動是健行 (hiking)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備地點與活動的邏輯連結。

questions.question: I ______ visit my grandparents next summer vacation.
questions.explanation: 未來簡單式動詞原形前加助動詞 will 表示預計執行動作。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 will 與 be going to 結構（此題後方無 going to，故優先選 will）。

questions.question: Don't forget to take a ______! This place is great.
questions.explanation: take a picture 為固定用法，「拍照」之意。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識固定搭配詞。

questions.question:
A: ______ Lily go to the concert with us tomorrow?
B: Yes, she will.
questions.explanation: 未來簡單式的疑問句，使用助動詞 Will 開頭，且回答也是用 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 慣性選 Does 或 Is，未注意時態對應。

questions.question: It ______ rain tomorrow. You should bring an umbrella.
questions.explanation: 描述明天的天氣預測，使用 will rain。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 tomorrow 影響誤選 is (應為 is going to 才對)。

questions.question:
A: Will you play basketball after school?
B: No, I ______. I have to study.
questions.explanation: 對 Will 開頭疑問句的否定簡答為 No, I won't (will not)。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選 don't，忽略助動詞的一致性。

questions.question: Sam and Leo ______ go swimming if the weather is hot.
questions.explanation: 表示未來的可能計畫，選用 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 受主詞複數影響誤選 are。

questions.question: She will ______ us a story tonight.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 之後應接「原形動詞」。
questions.commonMisconception: 受單三影響加 s，或受已發生的事影響加 ed。

questions.question: Amy ______ see a movie with her mom next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 未來式最標準助動詞為 will。選項 B 缺少 to，D 項目缺少 B 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 對 be going to 的殘缺形式辨識力不足。

questions.question:
We will take the forest train in Alishan. We will see the beautiful sunrise (日出). 
Question: What time will they most likely wake up?
questions.explanation: 要看日出 (sunrise)，通常需要「清晨非常早」起床。
questions.commonMisconception: 對自然現象與生活作息的邏輯連結不夠敏銳。

questions.question:
Friday: Rain. Saturday: Sunny. Sunday: Cloudy.
Question: Which day will be the best for hiking?
questions.explanation: 晴天 (Sunny) 最適合戶外健行。
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊比對錯誤，或不認識天氣單字。

questions.question:
We are going camping. I will bring my tent. Amy will bring the food. Ken stays home.
Question: Does Ken go camping with them?
questions.explanation: 文中說 Ken stays home，故他不去露營。針對未來問句，回答用 won't。D 雖然語意對，但簡答格式未對應問句。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚問句時態或簡答格式要求。

questions.question:
Next year, Leo will learn how to play the guitar. He wants to form a band.
Question: What is Leo's future plan?
questions.explanation: 他要學吉他並「組樂團」(form a band)，故未來計畫是在樂團演奏。
questions.commonMisconception: 不懂 form a band 的含義。

questions.question:
If you visit the zoo, you will see elephants. If you visit the mountains, you will see birds. 
Question: What will you see if you go hiking?
questions.explanation: 去爬山 (mountains) 對應去健行 (hiking)，會看到的是鳥類。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行活動與地點的同義/類義轉換。

questions.question: My father ______ go to Taipei and visit his friend tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 未來式可以使用 will 也可以使用 be going to。此題檢驗學生對未來式雙重結構的認知。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤以為只能擇一使用，或是對 A and B 的選項模式不熟悉。

questions.question: The park is dirty. We ______ help clean it up next weekend.
questions.explanation: 時間副詞 next weekend 提示未來式。
questions.commonMisconception: 受到 park is dirty 現在進行的狀況誘導而未注意時間副詞。

questions.question:
A: Can you swim?
B: No, but I ______ learn this summer.
questions.explanation: 表示這個暑假的未來決定/計畫，選用 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 Can you... 開頭影響大腦中的助動詞序列。

questions.question: If you visit China, you will see the Great Wall. It is very ______.
questions.explanation: 萬里長城 (Great Wall) 以其「長」度聞名。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備世界地標的基本常識性形容詞對應。

questions.question: In Alishan, you can take a ______ to the top of the mountain.
questions.explanation: 阿里山以森林鐵路 (forest train) 聞名。
questions.commonMisconception: 對在地觀光特色不熟悉。

questions.question:
I am not a bird, but I can fly. I will carry you to Japan.
Question: Who am I?
questions.explanation: 會飛且能帶人去日本的交通工具是飛機 (plane)。
questions.commonMisconception: 對交通工具與其功能/特徵的對應力不足。
